body:
## :star: New Features

- Deprecate AppOptics as it has retired [#51810](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51810)
- Improve classpath entry lookup performance during jar creation and extraction [#51787](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/51787)
- Add spring.kafka.listener.await-async-results-on-stop property [#51774](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/51774)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- spring.http.clients.cookie-handling has no effect when using a reactive client backed by an HttpComponents connector [#51767](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51767)
- NullPointerException can be thrown when using uber jars due to a race condition in NestedJarFileResources  [#51746](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51746)
- Connection fails when rabbitmq Docker Compose service is configured to use SSL [#51668](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51668)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document support for Java 27 [#51826](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51826)
- Fix broken links from reference documentation to external Javadoc [#51821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51821)
- Remove reference to AppOptics in the reference guide as it has retired [#51809](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51809)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to [ActiveMQ 6.3.2](https://activemq.apache.org/components/classic/download/classic-06-03-02) [#51669](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51669)
- Upgrade to [Artemis 2.57.0](https://activemq.apache.org/components/artemis/download/release-notes-2.57.0) [#51670](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51670)
- Upgrade to [Build Helper Maven Plugin 3.6.2](https://github.com/mojohaus/build-helper-maven-plugin/releases/tag/3.6.2) [#51734](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51734)

## :warning: Attention Required

- Spring Boot's Gradle plugin no longer automatically configures gRPC when the Protobuf plugin is applied. This behavior caused problems for those using Protobuf without gRPC. To opt in to the configuration of gRPC, configure the `protobuf` extension with the `grpc` plugin using an empty block. The Spring Boot Gradle plugin will then automatically configure the use of `protoc-gen-grpc-java` as before. [#50822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50822)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Kafka consumer-specific security protocol is not taken into account [#51369](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51369)
- Structured logging: a failed JSON encode corrupts the next log event written on the same thread [#51156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/51156)
- Micrometer registries pin the application context [#51135](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51135)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Description of spring.graphql.websocket.connection-init-timeout does not render correctly in the reference guide [#51348](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/51348)
- spring.profiles.group should have a 'spring-profile-name' hint provider [#51284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51284)
- Remove reference to removed InfluxDB auto-configuration [#51176](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51176)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to ActiveMQ 6.2.9 [#51329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51329)
- Upgrade to [Byte Buddy 1.18.11](https://github.com/raphw/byte-buddy/releases/tag/byte-buddy-1.18.11) [#51003](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51003)
- Upgrade to CycloneDX Maven Plugin 2.9.3 [#51185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51185)

## :star: New Features

- Add public constructor to InvalidConfigurationPropertyValueException that accepts a cause [#50211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50211)
- Reduce memory consumption when repeatedly calling WritableJson.toByteArray [#49428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/49428)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- MailSender auto-configuration does not enable hostname verification [#50747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50747)
- Artemis auto-configuration uses a predictable default location for the embedded broker's data [#50745](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50745)
- Embedded LDAP SSL should not be enabled when its bundle is empty [#50700](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/pull/50700)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix reference to Gradle documentation for module replacement [#50647](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50647)
- Document SSL reloading with Let's Encrypt [#50630](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50630)
- Remove the use of Optional from Data Neo4j repository examples [#50622](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50622)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to ActiveMQ 6.2.6 [#50652](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50652)
- Upgrade to Byte Buddy 1.18.10 [#50693](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50693)
- Upgrade to [Caffeine 3.2.4](https://github.com/ben-manes/caffeine/releases/tag/v3.2.4) [#50338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/50338)
